_comment: Example for: python relocate.py --config relocate.example.json   Copy it, put in your own locations, and remove the keys you do not need. Keys that start with _ are ignored. Flags on the command line win over this file.
_optional: PYTHON defaults to GBF_REPO/.venv/Scripts/python.exe; GSR_ROOT to the parent of GSR_TRAIN_DIR; TOOLS_ROOT, PIPELINE_ROOT, EVIDENCE_ROOT, PATCH_DIR and LEADCFG_ROOT to folders inside this package. Set them only when you moved those folders.
